        function generateRequestCard(req, index, isMyRequest = false) {
            let sec = 0; const c = req.createdAt;
            if (c) { if (typeof c.toDate === 'function') sec = c.toDate().getTime() / 1000; else if (c instanceof Date) sec = c.getTime() / 1000; else if (c.seconds) sec = c.seconds; }
            const when = !sec ? 'Just now' : (Date.now() / 1000 - sec > 7 * 86400 ? new Date(sec * 1000).toLocaleDateString() : ago(sec));
            const done = req.status === 'completed';
            const pill = done ? '<span class="pill pill-ok"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Fulfilled</span>'
                : (req.isEmergency ? '<span class="pill pill-e"><i class="dot"></i>Emergency</span>' : '<span class="pill pill-s">Standard</span>');
            const place = [req.hospital, req.location].filter(Boolean).map(esc).join(', ');
            const call = (!isMyRequest && !done) ? `<a href="tel:${esc(req.phone)}" onclick="event.stopPropagation()" class="rc-call ${req.isEmergency ? 'rc-call-e' : ''}" aria-label="Call"><i class="fa-solid fa-phone"></i></a>` : '';
            const actions = isMyRequest ? `<div class="rc-actions">${!done ? `<button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); prepareEdit(${index})" class="rc-btn rc-edit"><i class="fa-solid fa-pen"></i> Edit</button>` : ''}<button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); deleteRequest(${index})" class="rc-btn rc-del"><i class="fa-solid fa-trash"></i> Delete</button></div>` : '';
            const handler = isMyRequest ? `openRequestModal(${index}, false)` : `openRequestModal(${index}, true)`;
            return `
            <div onclick="${handler}" class="req-card ${req.isEmergency && !done ? 'urgent' : ''} ${done ? 'done' : ''}">
                <div class="rc-blood">${esc(req.blood)}</div>
                <div class="rc-main">
                    <div class="rc-top"><b>${esc(req.patient)}</b><span class="rc-time">${when}</span></div>
                    <p class="rc-loc"><i class="fa-solid fa-location-dot"></i><span>${place}</span></p>
                    <div class="rc-tags">${req.problem ? `<span class="rc-prob"><i class="fa-solid fa-notes-medical"></i><span>${esc(req.problem)}</span></span>` : ''}${pill}</div>
                </div>
                ${call}${actions}
            </div>`;
        }

                        const dateStr = h.date ? new Date(h.date.seconds * 1000).toLocaleDateString() : 'N/A';
                        html += `
                        <div class="flex justify-between items-center bg-white p-2 rounded border border-gray-100 mb-1">
                            <div>
                                <p class="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700">Saved: ${esc(h.patient)}</p>
                                <p class="text-[10px] text-gray-400">${dateStr}</p>
                            </div>
                            <div class="text-green-500"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i></div>
                        </div>`;
                    });
                    section.innerHTML = html;

                } catch (e) {
                    console.error(e);
                    section.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-xs text-red-400 py-2">Error loading history.</p>';
                }

            } else {
                section.classList.add('hidden');
                arrow.classList.remove('rotate-90');
            }
        }

        function showToast(msg) {
            const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
            toast.innerText = msg;
            toast.style.opacity = '1';
            setTimeout(() => toast.style.opacity = '0', 3000);
        }
        function toggleLoader(idPrefix, isLoading) {
            const loader = document.getElementById(idPrefix + '-loader');
            const btnText = document.querySelector(`#btn-${idPrefix} span`);
            if(isLoading) {
                loader.style.display = 'block';
                if(btnText) btnText.style.display = 'none';
            } else {
                loader.style.display = 'none';
                if(btnText) btnText.style.display = 'block';
            }
        }

        // ===== PROFESSIONAL ENHANCEMENTS =====
        function esc(v) {
            return String(v ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":'''}[c]));
        }
        window.esc = esc;

        // Offline banner
        const offlineBanner = document.getElementById('offline-banner');
        const syncOnline = () => offlineBanner.classList.toggle('show', !navigator.onLine);
        window.addEventListener('online', syncOnline); window.addEventListener('offline', syncOnline); syncOnline();

        // Share helpers
        async function shareText(title, text) {
            const url = location.href.split('#')[0];
            try {
                if (navigator.share) { await navigator.share({ title, text, url }); return; }
                await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text + ' ' + url);
                showToast('Copied to clipboard');
            } catch (e) { /* user cancelled */ }
        }
        window.shareApp = () => shareText('LifeBlood', 'Join LifeBlood - find blood donors and save lives in Bangladesh.');
        window.shareRequestModal = () => {
            const g = id => document.getElementById(id).innerText.trim();
            const urgent = !document.getElementById('req-modal-badge').classList.contains('hidden');
            const phone = (document.getElementById('req-modal-call').getAttribute('href') || '').replace('tel:', '');
            shareText('Blood needed', `${urgent ? 'URGENT: ' : ''}${g('req-modal-blood')} blood needed at ${g('req-modal-hospital')}, ${g('req-modal-location')}. Date: ${g('req-modal-date')}. Contact: ${phone}`);
        };
        window.whatsappFrom = (anchorId) => {
            let n = (document.getElementById(anchorId).getAttribute('href') || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
            if (!n) return showToast('No phone number available');
            if (n.startsWith('0')) n = '88' + n;
            window.open('https://wa.me/' + n, '_blank', 'noopener');
        };

        // Donation eligibility (recommended gap: 120 days)
        const DONATION_GAP_DAYS = 120;
        async function refreshEligibility() {
            const t = document.getElementById('elig-title'); if (!t || !auth.currentUser) return;
            try {
                const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "donations"), where("donorId", "==", auth.currentUser.uid)));
                let last = 0; snap.forEach(d => { const x = d.data().date; const ms = x?.seconds ? x.seconds * 1000 : 0; if (ms > last) last = ms; });
                const icon = document.getElementById('elig-icon'), bar = document.getElementById('elig-bar'), sub = document.getElementById('elig-sub');
                if (!last) { t.innerText = 'Ready to donate'; sub.innerText = 'No donation recorded yet'; bar.style.width = '100%'; return; }
                const days = Math.floor((Date.now() - last) / 86400000), left = DONATION_GAP_DAYS - days;
                if (left <= 0) { t.innerText = 'You can donate again'; bar.style.width = '100%'; bar.className = 'h-full bg-emerald-500 rounded-full'; sub.innerText = 'Last donation ' + days + ' days ago'; }
                else { t.innerText = 'Eligible in ' + left + ' days'; bar.style.width = Math.round(days / DONATION_GAP_DAYS * 100) + '%'; bar.className = 'h-full bg-amber-500 rounded-full'; icon.className = icon.className.replace('emerald', 'amber'); sub.innerText = 'Last donation ' + new Date(last).toLocaleDateString() + ' - rest for ' + DONATION_GAP_DAYS / 30 + ' months'; }
            } catch (e) { t.innerText = 'Eligibility unavailable'; }
        }

        // Donor badge
        function renderBadge() {
            const c = currentUserData?.donationCount || 0;
            const tiers = [[10, 'Life Hero', 'text-rose-600 bg-rose-50'], [5, 'Gold donor', 'text-amber-500 bg-amber-50'], [3, 'Silver donor', 'text-slate-500 bg-slate-100'], [1, 'Bronze donor', 'text-orange-600 bg-orange-50']];
            const tier = tiers.find(x => c >= x[0]); const next = [...tiers].reverse().find(x => c < x[0]);
            document.getElementById('badge-title').innerText = tier ? tier[1] : 'New donor';
            document.getElementById('badge-icon').className = 'w-12 h-12 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xl ' + (tier ? tier[2] : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-400');
            document.getElementById('badge-sub').innerText = next ? (next[0] - c) + ' more donation' + (next[0] - c > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' to reach ' + next[1] : 'Highest level reached. Thank you!';
        }
        const _loadProfile = loadProfile;
        loadProfile = function () { _loadProfile(); renderBadge(); refreshEligibility(); const hb = document.getElementById('hero-blood'); if (hb) hb.innerText = currentUserData?.blood || '--'; };

        // Compatibility guide
        const COMPAT = { 'O-': ['All groups', 'O-'], 'O+': ['O+, A+, B+, AB+', 'O+, O-'], 'A-': ['A+, A-, AB+, AB-', 'A-, O-'], 'A+': ['A+, AB+', 'A+, A-, O+, O-'], 'B-': ['B+, B-, AB+, AB-', 'B-, O-'], 'B+': ['B+, AB+', 'B+, B-, O+, O-'], 'AB-': ['AB+, AB-', 'AB-, A-, B-, O-'], 'AB+': ['AB+', 'All groups'] };
        document.getElementById('compat-body').innerHTML = Object.entries(COMPAT).map(([g, [to, from]]) =>
            `<tr><td class="font-black text-rose-600">${g}</td><td class="text-xs text-gray-600">${to}</td><td class="text-xs text-gray-600">${from}</td></tr>`).join('');

        // Eligibility checklist
        const CHECKS = [['I am 18-60 years old', 1], ['I weigh at least 50 kg', 1], ['I feel healthy today (no fever, cold or infection)', 1], ['My last donation was more than 4 months ago', 1], ['I have not had a tattoo, piercing or surgery in the last 6 months', 1], ['I am pregnant, breastfeeding or on antibiotics', 0], ['I have been diagnosed with hepatitis, HIV or a blood disorder', 0]];
        const checkList = document.getElementById('check-list');
        checkList.innerHTML = CHECKS.map((c, i) => `<label class="flex items-start gap-3 bg-slate-50 p-3 rounded-xl cursor-pointer"><input type="checkbox" data-i="${i}" class="mt-1 accent-rose-600"><span>${c[0]}</span></label>`).join('');
        checkList.addEventListener('change', () => {
            const boxes = [...checkList.querySelectorAll('input')];
            const okAll = boxes.every((b, i) => CHECKS[i][1] ? b.checked : !b.checked);
            const res = document.getElementById('check-result');
            res.className = 'mt-4 p-3 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold ' + (okAll ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700' : 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700');
            res.innerText = okAll ? 'You look eligible. Visit a donation centre to confirm.' : 'You may not be eligible right now. Check with a doctor or blood bank.';
        });

        // ===== MOTION =====
        function countUp(el, to, ms = 900) {
            if (!el || matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) { if (el) el.innerText = to; return; }
            const t0 = performance.now();
            const tick = t => { const k = Math.min(1, (t - t0) / ms); el.innerText = Math.round(to * (1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 3))); if (k < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick); };
            requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        }
        const _lp2 = loadProfile;
        loadProfile = function () { _lp2(); countUp(document.getElementById('profile-donations-count'), currentUserData?.donationCount || 0); };
        document.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
            const b = e.target.closest('button, .tile, .tool'); if (!b || b.disabled) return;
            if (getComputedStyle(b).position === 'static') b.style.position = 'relative';
            b.style.overflow = 'hidden';
            const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(), d = document.createElement('span');
            d.className = 'rip'; d.style.left = (e.clientX - r.left) + 'px'; d.style.top = (e.clientY - r.top) + 'px';
            b.appendChild(d); setTimeout(() => d.remove(), 650);
        });

        // ===== LIVE HOME =====
        const GREET = () => { const h = new Date().getHours(); return h < 5 ? 'Still up?' : h < 12 ? 'Good morning' : h < 17 ? 'Good afternoon' : h < 21 ? 'Good evening' : 'Good night'; };
        const TIPS = ['One donation can help save up to three lives.', 'Healthy adults can donate every 4 months.', 'Drink water and eat well before you donate.', 'A donation takes about 10 minutes of your time.'];
        let tipIdx = 0;
        function paintGreeting() { const g = document.getElementById('hero-greet'); if (g) g.innerText = GREET(); }
        paintGreeting(); setInterval(paintGreeting, 60000);
        setInterval(() => {
            const el = document.getElementById('hero-tip'); if (!el) return;
            el.style.opacity = 0; el.style.transform = 'translateY(6px)';
            setTimeout(() => { tipIdx = (tipIdx + 1) % TIPS.length; el.innerText = TIPS[tipIdx]; el.style.opacity = ''; el.style.transform = ''; }, 400);
        }, 6000);

        function ago(sec) {
            if (!sec) return 'Just now';
            const m = Math.floor((Date.now() / 1000 - sec) / 60);
            if (m < 1) return 'Just now'; if (m < 60) return m + ' min ago';
            const h = Math.floor(m / 60); if (h < 24) return h + ' hr ago';
            return Math.floor(h / 24) + ' d ago';
        }
        let liveReqs = null, liveUnsub = null;
        function renderLive() {
            const strip = document.getElementById('live-strip'); if (!strip || !liveReqs) return;
            if (!liveReqs.length) { strip.innerHTML = '<div class="live-empty"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check mb-1 block text-base" style="color:#16A34A"></i>No active requests right now.</div>'; return; }
            strip.innerHTML = liveReqs.slice(0, 6).map((r, i) => `
                <button onclick="openRequestModal(${i}, true)" class="live-card ${r.isEmergency ? 'urgent' : ''}" style="animation-delay:${i * 60}ms">
                    <span class="bg">${esc(r.blood)}</span>
                    <span class="info">
                        <b>${esc(r.patient)}</b>
                        <small>${esc(r.hospital)}, ${esc(r.location)}</small>
                        <em>${r.isEmergency ? '<i class="dot"></i>Emergency' : 'Standard'}<span>${ago(r.createdAt?.seconds)}</span></em>
                    </span>
                    <i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-right chev"></i>
                </button>`).join('');
        }
        function startLiveHome() {
            if (liveUnsub || !auth.currentUser) return;
            liveUnsub = onSnapshot(query(collection(db, "requests"), where("status", "==", "active")), snap => {
                const arr = []; snap.forEach(d => arr.push(d.data()));
                arr.sort((a, b) => (b.createdAt?.seconds || 0) - (a.createdAt?.seconds || 0));
                liveReqs = arr; window.feedData = arr;
                countUp(document.getElementById('stat-active'), arr.length, 600);
                renderLive(); renderFeedFiltered();
            }, () => { liveUnsub = null; });
            setInterval(renderLive, 60000);
            (async () => {
                try {
                    const countOf = async q => { try { const m = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.7.1/firebase-firestore.js"); return (await m.getCountFromServer(q)).data().count; } catch (e) { return (await getDocs(q)).size; } };
                    countOf(query(collection(db, "users"), where("role", "==", "donor"))).then(n => countUp(document.getElementById('stat-donors'), n, 1100)).catch(() => { const c = document.getElementById('stat-donors')?.closest('.stat'); if (c) c.style.display = 'none'; });
                    countOf(query(collection(db, "requests"), where("status", "==", "completed"))).then(n => countUp(document.getElementById('stat-helped'), n, 1100)).catch(() => {});
                } catch (e) { /* stats are optional */ }
            })();
        }
        const _lp3 = loadProfile;
        loadProfile = function () { _lp3(); startLiveHome(); };
        document.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { if (e.target.closest('button, .tile, .tool, .live-card')) navigator.vibrate?.(8); });

        const _lp4 = loadProfile;
        loadProfile = function () { _lp4(); const a = document.getElementById('hero-avatar'); if (a) a.innerText = ((currentUserData?.name || '?').trim()[0] || '?').toUpperCase(); };

        // ===== FEED PAGE =====
        const FEED_CHIPS = ['All', 'Emergency', 'A+', 'A-', 'B+', 'B-', 'O+', 'O-', 'AB+', 'AB-'];
        let feedFilter = 'All';
        function renderFeedChips() {
            const box = document.getElementById('feed-filters'); if (!box) return;
            box.innerHTML = FEED_CHIPS.map(c => `<button onclick="setFeedFilter('${c}')" class="chip ${c === feedFilter ? 'on' : ''}">${c}</button>`).join('');
        }
        window.setFeedFilter = f => { feedFilter = f; renderFeedChips(); renderFeedFiltered(); };
        function renderFeedFiltered() {
            const list = document.getElementById('feed-list'), count = document.getElementById('feed-count');
            if (!list || !Array.isArray(window.feedData)) return;
            const items = [];
            window.feedData.forEach((r, i) => { if (feedFilter === 'All' || (feedFilter === 'Emergency' ? r.isEmergency : r.blood === feedFilter)) items.push(generateRequestCard(r, i)); });
            const n = items.length;
            count.innerText = n + (n === 1 ? ' active request' : ' active requests') + (feedFilter !== 'All' ? ' \u00B7 ' + feedFilter : '');
            list.innerHTML = n ? items.join('') : '<div class="feed-empty"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i>No requests match this filter.</div>';
        }
        renderFeedChips();
        const _lgr = loadGlobalRequests;
        loadGlobalRequests = async function () { await _lgr(); renderFeedFiltered(); };

        // ===== PROFILE EXTRAS =====
        window.openMyRequests = () => { navTo('page-request'); switchReqTab('all'); };
        window.shareDonorCard = () => {
            const u = currentUserData; if (!u) return;
            shareText('LifeBlood donor', u.blood + ' blood donor from ' + (u.district || 'Bangladesh') + ' on LifeBlood. Find donors and save lives.');
        };
        window.openEditProfile = () => {
            const u = currentUserData; if (!u) return;
            document.getElementById('ep-name').value = u.name || '';
            document.getElementById('ep-phone').value = u.phone || '';
            document.getElementById('ep-district').value = u.district || '';
            openModal('edit-profile-modal');
        };
        window.saveProfile = async () => {
            const name = document.getElementById('ep-name').value.trim();
            const phone = document.getElementById('ep-phone').value.trim();
            const district = document.getElementById('ep-district').value;
            if (!name) return showToast('Please enter your name');
            if (!/^[0-9+\-\s]{6,16}$/.test(phone)) return showToast('Enter a valid phone number');
            if (!district) return showToast('Please select a district');
            const btn = document.getElementById('ep-save'); btn.disabled = true; btn.innerText = 'Saving...';
            try {
                await updateDoc(doc(db, "users", auth.currentUser.uid), { name, phone, district });
                Object.assign(currentUserData, { name, phone, district });
                loadProfile(); closeModal('edit-profile-modal'); showToast('Profile updated');
            } catch (e) { showToast('Could not save. Try again.'); }
            btn.disabled = false; btn.innerText = 'Save changes';
        };
        async function refreshProfileExtras() {
            const c = currentUserData?.donationCount || 0;
            const lives = document.getElementById('pf-lives'); if (lives) lives.innerText = c * 3;
            const t = document.getElementById('pf-elig-title'); if (!t || !auth.currentUser) return;
            const sub = document.getElementById('pf-elig-sub'), bar = document.getElementById('pf-elig-bar'), ic = document.getElementById('pf-elig-ic');
            try {
                const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "donations"), where("donorId", "==", auth.currentUser.uid)));
                let last = 0; snap.forEach(d => { const x = d.data().date; const ms = x?.seconds ? x.seconds * 1000 : 0; if (ms > last) last = ms; });
                if (!last) { t.innerText = 'Ready to donate'; sub.innerText = 'No donation recorded yet'; bar.style.width = '100%'; bar.style.background = '#16A34A'; return; }
                const days = Math.floor((Date.now() - last) / 86400000), left = DONATION_GAP_DAYS - days;
                if (left <= 0) { t.innerText = 'You can donate again'; sub.innerText = 'Last donation ' + days + ' days ago'; bar.style.width = '100%'; bar.style.background = '#16A34A'; ic.className = 'fa-solid fa-calendar-check'; }
                else { t.innerText = 'Eligible in ' + left + ' days'; sub.innerText = 'Last donation ' + new Date(last).toLocaleDateString(); bar.style.width = Math.round(days / DONATION_GAP_DAYS * 100) + '%'; bar.style.background = '#D97706'; ic.className = 'fa-solid fa-hourglass-half'; }
            } catch (e) { t.innerText = 'Status unavailable'; }
            try {
                const rs = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "requests"), where("createdBy", "==", auth.currentUser.uid)));
                const n = rs.size, el = document.getElementById('pf-req-count');
                if (el) { el.innerText = n; el.classList.toggle('hidden', !n); }
            } catch (e) {}
        }
        const _lpExtras = loadProfile;
        loadProfile = function () { _lpExtras(); refreshProfileExtras(); };

        let _sdT; window.debouncedSearch = () => { clearTimeout(_sdT); _sdT = setTimeout(() => searchDonors(), 350); };
    </script>
